sub_graphs.title: EIP-7951: secp256r1 Precompile Execution Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of a call to the secp256r1 signature verification precompile from invocation to result

nodes.label: Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: EVM has initiated a call to precompile address 0x100 with calldata

nodes.label: Charge Fixed Gas (6900)
nodes.description: Deduct the fixed gas cost of 6900 for secp256r1 verification

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Gas has been deducted, precompile execution proceeds

nodes.label: Parse 160-byte Input
nodes.description: Extract h (32), r (32), s (32), qx (32), qy (32) from calldata

nodes.label: Input Components Extracted
nodes.description: Message hash, signature components, and public key coordinates extracted

nodes.label: Execute ECDSA Verification
nodes.description: Compute s1 = s^(-1) mod n, R' = (h*s1)*G + (r*s1)*(qx,qy), verify r' ≡ r mod n

nodes.label: Signature Valid
nodes.description: Verification succeeded, signature matches public key and message

nodes.label: Verification Failed
nodes.description: Signature verification failed or input was invalid

nodes.label: Return Success (0x01)
nodes.description: Return 32-byte value 0x0000...0001 indicating valid signature

nodes.label: Return Empty Output
nodes.description: Return 0 bytes indicating invalid signature or malformed input

nodes.label: Precompile Execution Complete
nodes.description: Precompile has returned, control returns to calling contract

external_entities.name: Calling Smart Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract invoking the secp256r1 precompile via CALL/STATICCALL

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7951: secp256r1 Input Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks performed on precompile inputs before signature verification

nodes.label: Raw Input Received
nodes.description: 160-byte calldata received from caller

nodes.label: Check Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input is exactly 160 bytes

nodes.label: Input Length Valid
nodes.description: Input is exactly 160 bytes

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input is not 160 bytes

nodes.label: Check Signature Bounds
nodes.description: Verify 0 < r < n and 0 < s < n where n is subgroup order

nodes.label: Signature Bounds Valid
nodes.description: r and s are within valid range (0, n)

nodes.label: Signature Bounds Invalid
nodes.description: r or s is outside valid range

nodes.label: Check Public Key Bounds
nodes.description: Verify 0 <= qx < p and 0 <= qy < p where p is field modulus

nodes.label: Public Key Bounds Valid
nodes.description: qx and qy are within field bounds

nodes.label: Public Key Bounds Invalid
nodes.description: qx or qy exceeds field modulus

nodes.label: Verify Curve Equation
nodes.description: Verify qy^2 ≡ qx^3 + a*qx + b (mod p)

nodes.label: Point On Curve
nodes.description: Public key point satisfies curve equation

nodes.label: Point Not On Curve
nodes.description: Public key does not satisfy curve equation

nodes.label: Check Point Not Infinity
nodes.description: Verify (qx, qy) != (0, 0) to prevent point-at-infinity attacks

nodes.label: Point Not At Infinity
nodes.description: Public key is a valid non-identity point

nodes.label: Point Is Infinity
nodes.description: Public key is the identity element (invalid)

nodes.label: All Validation Passed
nodes.description: All input validation checks succeeded

edges.label: r or s out of range
qx or qy out of range

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7951: External Input Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries and security checks when external signature data enters the system

nodes.label: Untrusted Input Received
nodes.description: External signature data received from untrusted caller

nodes.label: Boundary Check: Format
nodes.description: Verify input conforms to expected 160-byte format

nodes.label: Boundary Check: Cryptographic Validity
nodes.description: Verify all cryptographic constraints (curve membership, bounds)

nodes.label: Input Sanitized
nodes.description: Input has passed all boundary checks

nodes.label: Input Rejected at Boundary
nodes.description: Input failed boundary checks, rejected safely

nodes.label: Consume Gas Regardless
nodes.description: Gas is consumed even for invalid inputs (DoS protection)

nodes.label: Gas Consumed Without Revert
nodes.description: Precompile consumes gas but returns empty, not reverts

external_entities.name: WebAuthn/FIDO2 Device
external_entities.description: External secure hardware (Apple Secure Enclave, Android Keystore, FIDO2) generating secp256r1 signatures

ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations may leak timing information. Applications requiring protection against timing attacks must implement additional countermeasures at the contract level.

ambiguities.text: Signatures are not required to be non-malleable per NIST FIPS 186-5
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume both (r, s) and (r, n-s) are valid signatures for the same message. Applications must implement low-s normalization if malleable signatures are a security concern.

implicit_assumptions.description: The secp256r1 curve parameters (NIST P-256) are cryptographically secure and not backdoored
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Complete compromise of all signature verification, allowing signature forgery

implicit_assumptions.description: Attacker cannot solve the ECDLP (Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem) on secp256r1
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could forge arbitrary signatures without knowing private keys

implicit_assumptions.description: The 6900 gas cost is sufficient to prevent DoS attacks via precompile spam
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network congestion or resource exhaustion from cheap verification calls
